proposals.before: That October Empress Guo was cast aside with an edict declaring her unfit to "maintain the ancestral sacrifices."
proposals.after: That tenth month Empress Guo was cast aside with an edict declaring her unfit to "maintain the ancestral sacrifices."
proposals.reason: 十月 is the tenth lunar month, not the Gregorian month October.

proposals.before: At month's end on renyin in the eighth month of Yongping 8 (65), a total eclipse reached eleven degrees in Dou.
proposals.after: At month's end on renyin in the tenth month of Yongping 8 (65), a total eclipse reached eleven degrees in Dou.
proposals.reason: Chinese has 十月 (tenth month); idiomatic wrongly says eighth month.

proposals.before: Two years later Empress Liang died and her brothers in the Liang clan were put to death.
proposals.after: Two years later Empress Liang died, and Yi and his brothers were executed.
proposals.reason: Chinese 翼兄弟 does not say Liang; idiomatic invents Liang-clan brothers. Literal already has Yi brothers.

proposals.before: That August six provinces were inundated and the Bohai tide surged over the coast.
proposals.after: That eighth month six provinces were inundated and the Bohai tide surged over the coast.
proposals.reason: 八月 is the eighth lunar month, not Gregorian August.

proposals.before: The princes had been patronizing scholars and debaters; the year before, a memorial warned that their clients included descendants of convicted men and demanded a vetting process."
proposals.after: The princes had been patronizing scholars and debaters; the year before, a memorial warned that their clients included descendants of convicted men and demanded a vetting process.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English ends with a stray closing quotation mark not opened in this sentence.

decisions.reason: 其十月 is the tenth lunar month; rendering it as Gregorian October is wrong, and neighboring units already use “Nth month,” so the proposed fix restores the source month without other change.
八年十月壬寅晦 names the tenth month; the idiomatic “eighth month” contradicts the Chinese and is correctly replaced by “tenth month.”

decisions.after: Two years later Empress Liang died, and Liang Ji and his brothers were executed.
decisions.reason: The transmitted text requires Liang Ji: 翼 is an OCR error for 冀 in 梁冀, and 冀兄弟 means Liang Ji and his brothers, not the empress's brothers generically.
其八月 is the eighth lunar month, not Gregorian August; the chapter’s dating style uses numbered months, and the proposed wording corrects only that error.
The idiomatic paraphrase does not open a quotation, yet ends with a stray closing quote; removing it restores grammatical English without changing meaning.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 有人上奏：「诸王所招待者，或真伪杂，受刑罚者子孙，宜可分别。」
